# Abouts Dots

In Quarto, Graphviz DOT diagrams work almost like Mermaid, using a fenced code block.

## Dot1
```{dot}
digraph G {
  rankdir = TB;

  Student -> Portal;
  Portal -> Admissions;
  Admissions -> Committee;
  Committee -> Admissions;
  Admissions -> Student;
}
```



## Dot2

```{dot}
//| label: fig-admission-dot
//| fig-cap: "Admission process using Graphviz DOT"
//| fig-width: 7
//| fig-height: 5
//| fig-align: center

digraph G {
  rankdir = TB;

  Student [shape=box];
  Portal [shape=box, label="Application Portal"];
  Admissions [shape=box, label="Admissions Office"];
  Committee [shape=box, label="Review Committee"];

  Student -> Portal [label="Submit application"];
  Portal -> Admissions [label="Forward application"];
  Admissions -> Committee [label="Send for review"];
  Committee -> Admissions [label="Decision"];
  Admissions -> Student [label="Notify decision"];
}
```


## Dot3

```{dot}
digraph G {
  rankdir = LR;

  Apply -> Verify -> Review -> Decision;
}
```
## Dot with Decisions
```{dot}
//| label: fig-admission-decision
//| fig-cap: "Admission decision flow"

digraph G {
  rankdir = TB;
  node [shape=box, style="rounded,filled", fillcolor="#EEF6FF", color="#2563EB"];
  edge [color="#374151"];

  Apply [label="Student applies"];
  Verify [label="Verify documents"];
  Complete [label="Complete?", shape=diamond, fillcolor="#FFF7E6", color="#C99700"];
  Missing [label="Request missing documents"];
  Review [label="Review application"];
  Decision [label="Decision", shape=diamond, fillcolor="#FFF7E6", color="#C99700"];
  Offer [label="Send offer letter"];
  Reject [label="Send rejection notice"];

  Apply -> Verify;
  Verify -> Complete;
  Complete -> Missing [label="No"];
  Missing -> Verify;
  Complete -> Review [label="Yes"];
  Review -> Decision;
  Decision -> Offer [label="Accepted"];
  Decision -> Reject [label="Rejected"];
}
```
## Left to Right

```{dot}
digraph G {
  rankdir = LR;

  Apply -> Verify -> Review -> Decision;
}
```



## Setting Graphviz DOT Options
For Mermaid you used `%%|`; for DOT, use `//|`.

### Common Dot Directions

rankdir = TB;  // top to bottom
rankdir = LR;  // left to right
rankdir = BT;  // bottom to top
rankdir = RL;  // right to left

### Common Shapes

shape=box
shape=ellipse
shape=diamond
shape=folder
shape=note
